stacks.notes: Yarn 4.18.1 workspaces (packages/*, plugins/*), TypeScript ~5.7, Node 22 || 24, Jest 30 via backstage-cli. No pre-authored mmo adapter matches, so the Tier 2b stack profile was built.

test_command_notes: Always give a path, and never run the whole suite. Needs `yarn install` first. Typecheck: `yarn tsc` from the root with no options. Lint: `yarn lint --fix`. API reports: `yarn build:api-reports`. Never run `yarn build`, `yarn changesets version` or `yarn release`.
env_keys_referenced_in_code_note: Top 20 by frequency, out of 113 distinct process.env names in packages/ and plugins/. No .env files at repo root.
regulated_repo_note: This is a standard open-source vulnerability-disclosure policy, not a compliance regime. There are no HIPAA, PCI, SOC2 or compliance folders, and CODEOWNERS names no security, compliance, privacy or legal teams.

off_limits_rationale.**/report*.api.md: Generated by `yarn build:api-reports` (316 tracked). Regenerate them with the tool and never edit them by hand.
off_limits_rationale.**/CHANGELOG.md: Generated at release from .changeset/*.md. Changes go in .changeset/ instead.
off_limits_rationale.docs/releases/**: CLAUDE.md says never edit past release notes.
off_limits_rationale.ESLint/Prettier/TS config: CLAUDE.md says never update these unless asked.

coexistence_notes: Cursor rules at .cursor/rules/ (backstage-project.mdc, tests/*.mdc). Untouched by default.
Claude Code project config at .claude/ (CLAUDE.md, settings.local.json, skills/catalog-db-performance.md, skills/backstage-release-notes). Untouched.
plugins/catalog-backend/CLAUDE.md asks that DB query, index or schema changes run the query-performance battery (src/tests/performance/query-battery/) and update queries.md/baseline.md.
No .mcp.json, Aider, Continue, Roo, routing-policy.yaml or gemini config found.
.gitignore does not cover .sdlc/, but .git/info/exclude does (local-only), so git add -A will not pick up .sdlc/ in this clone.
husky + lint-staged pre-commit hooks run eslint --fix, prettier, the docs-quality check and catalog-info generation on commit.
